logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- '[PAPI][ORDER] Processing started' ++ ' | phone: ' ++ payload.customer.phoneNumber ++ ' | items: ' ++ (sizeOf(payload.items) as String) ++ ' | channel: '++ payload.orderChannel ++ ' | correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
#[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- '[PAPI][STOCK] Checking stock for ' ++ (sizeOf(vars.originalRequest.items) as String) ++ ' SKUs | correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
#[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- '[PAPI][STOCK] Stock data received' ++ ' | skuCount: ' ++ (sizeOf(payload) as String)]
#[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- '[PAPI][ORDER] Stock check | ' ++ 'sku: ' ++ vars.currentItem.sku ++ ' | qty: ' ++ (vars.itemStock.available_quantity default 0 as String)]

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- '[PAPI][ORDER] Placing order' ++ ' | orderId: ' ++ vars.generatedOrderId ++ ' | sku: ' ++ vars.currentItem.sku ++ ' | qty: ' ++ (vars.currentItem.quantity as String)]

http:request.http:body: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { orderId: vars.generatedOrderId, phoneNumber: vars.originalRequest.customer.phoneNumber, sku: vars.currentItem.sku, quantity: vars.currentItem.quantity, orderChannel: vars.originalRequest.orderChannel, paymentMode: vars.originalRequest.paymentMode, deliveryPreference: vars.originalRequest.deliveryPreference }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.itemResults ++ [{ sku: vars.currentItem.sku, quantity: vars.currentItem.quantity, status: "Order Placed", orderId: vars.generatedOrderId }]

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- '[PAPI][ORDER] Order placed' ++ ' | orderId: ' ++ vars.generatedOrderId ++ ' | sku: ' ++ vars.currentItem.sku]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.itemResults ++ [{ sku: vars.currentItem.sku, quantity: vars.currentItem.quantity, status: "Sorry, not placed", reason: "Rare Condition Failure: Sku out of stock" }]

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- '[PAPI][ORDER] Race condition — stock gone' ++ ' | sku: ' ++ vars.currentItem.sku]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.itemResults ++ [{ sku: vars.currentItem.sku, quantity: vars.currentItem.quantity, status: "Sorry, not placed", reason: "Requested Quantity > Available Quantity" }]

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- '[PAPI][ORDER] Out of stock' ++ ' | sku: ' ++ vars.currentItem.sku ++ ' | requested: ' ++ (vars.currentItem.quantity as String) ++ ' | available: ' ++ (vars.itemStock.availableQuantity default 0 as String)]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.itemResults ++ [{ sku: vars.currentItem.sku, quantity: vars.currentItem.quantity, status: "Sorry, not placed", reason: "Sku not available to order" }]

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- '[PAPI][ORDER] Sku not found' ++ ' | sku: ' ++ vars.currentItem.sku ++ ' | requested: ' ++ (vars.currentItem.quantity as String) ++ ' | available: ' ++ (vars.itemStock.availableQuantity default 0 as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log Final ResponseBuilt
